name: 实现 DeployTask 状态机
description: 实现 DeployTask 状态机模块。定义 TransitionRule 结构体表示(from, to, trigger, actor)四元组。定义 8 条合法转换规则：pending→running, pending→cancelled, running→success, running→failed, running→rollbacking, running→cancelled, rollbacking→rolled_back, rollbacking→rollback_failed。核心方法：CanTransition(from, to DeployStatus) bool 校验合法；MustTransition(from, to DeployStatus, actor string) error 执行转换并校验终态规则（success/rolled_back/rollback_failed/cancelled 不可逆转）。提供 TransitionGraph 数组用于遍历。产出物：状态机模块文件。
